tool_input.command:
sed -n '1,260p' src/session.js && printf '
--- package ---
' && sed -n '1,200p' package.json && printf '
--- readme ---
' && sed -n '1,240p' README.md

git status --short && /runtime/node --input-type=module <<'EOF'
import { Session } from './src/session.js'
const events=[]
const session=new Session({queryFn: ({signal}) => { events.push({aborted: signal.aborted}); return 'stop' }},{online:false})
const h=session.subscribe('stops',{networkMode:'online'})
session.unsubscribe(h)
session.online(true)
await Promise.resolve()
console.log(JSON.stringify({events,state:session.snapshot('stops')}))
EOF

/runtime/node --input-type=module <<'EOF'
import { Session } from './src/session.js'

const events=[]
const offline=new Session({queryFn: ({signal}) => { events.push(signal.aborted); return 'Central' }},{online:false})
const h=offline.subscribe('stops',{networkMode:'online'})
offline.unsubscribe(h)
offline.online(true)
await Promise.resolve()
console.log('offline-reconnect',JSON.stringify({events,state:offline.snapshot('stops')}))

let resolve
let seen
const consumed=new Session({queryFn: ({signal}) => { seen=signal; return new Promise(r=>resolve=r) }})
const h2=consumed.subscribe('stops')
consumed.unsubscribe(h2)
resolve('late')
await Promise.resolve()
console.log('consumed-cancel',JSON.stringify({aborted:seen.aborted,state:consumed.snapshot('stops')}))

let resolve2
const retained=new Session({queryFn: () => new Promise(r=>resolve2=r)})
const h3=retained.subscribe('stops')
retained.unsubscribe(h3)
resolve2('cached')
await Promise.resolve()
console.log('unconsumed-retained',JSON.stringify(retained.snapshot('stops')))
EOF
/runtime/node --check src/session.js
